parsed.understanding: Extract distinct clinical attributes that can be measured from a patient record excerpt and return each as a candidate with a name, description, basis, and uncertainty.
parsed.input_meaning: A dated clinical excerpt reporting two serum creatinine measurements and a CT imaging finding of emphysema.

candidates.name: Serum creatinine concentration
candidates.description: The measured concentration of creatinine in a serum or blood sample.
candidates.basis: The excerpt reports serum creatinine values of 1.0 mg/dL on 2025-01-01 and 1.2 mg/dL on 2025-01-10.

candidates.name: Emphysema on imaging
candidates.description: A computed tomography imaging finding indicating the presence of emphysema.
candidates.basis: The excerpt states that CT documents emphysema.
